title: Midnight
author: Sol
content: It's midnight. The city is dark and quiet, and I have lots of cozy lights in my room. I was actually supposed to go to bed two and a half hour ago, but i was a bit stessed over school work. I felt like I had not done anything with the portfolio assignment in IDATT1003. I feel the stess build up in my entire body. The exap period is soon upon us. Any time I overhear someone talk about an assignment or exams I feel the stress build upp in my body. I feel like I have to much to do...

title: Morning
author: Sol
content: The sky was a soft grey this morning, and the flat felt quiet. I put the kettle on and made a cup of tea while the rain drizzled gently outside. Afternoon tea was a simple affair—earl grey and a scone with a little clotted cream. There’s something comforting about the small routines.

title: Walk
author: Sol
content: Went for a walk through the park after lunch. The leaves have turned a warm mix of russet and gold, crunching pleasantly underfoot. A few people hurried past with umbrellas, but the drizzle didn’t bother me. Back home, I brewed a mug of cocoa and curled up with a book. The cat claimed the sunniest patch of carpet, looking perfectly satisfied.

title: Foggy morning breakfast
author: Sol
content: The morning was foggy, lending a gentle hush to the street. The post arrived—neatly folded letters that felt oddly proper. Breakfast was toast with marmalade, buttered just so. Later, I lit a candle and had the radio on low; the soft crackle made the flat feel a little more homely.
